Secondary: platform-level moderation for student submissions and auto-summarization for teacher notes. Target latency: conversational (<= 400ms median generation for short prompts), throughput modest (tens of concurrent sessions). Cost sensitivity high — SMB with per-student cost targets. Prefer public cloud hosted API and self-serve trial. Model preference: small-to-mid open model or Redwood curated hosted option; fallback routing acceptable to cheaper variants for non-interactive tasks.
